description: We're a team of B.Tech Computer Science students interested in AI/ML, especially multimodal AI and vision-language models. We're looking for teammates who are curious and ready to learn. Skills we'd love to have: Python, data analysis, UI/UX or web development, and storytelling for the final presentation. Beginners are welcome. We speak Bengali, English, and Hindi.
summary:
TerraWaltz is an interactive Earth-observation platform designed to transform satellite radar data into meaningful environmental insights. Focusing on the Indian Sundarbans, West Bengal, it explores how NASA–ISRO’s NISAR mission can help monitor changes in vulnerable coastal ecosystems.

The platform integrates NISAR radar observations and geospatial technologies to support the analysis of flooding, water extent, mangrove vegetation changes, shoreline movement, and agricultural transformation. Through interactive 2D maps, 3D spatial visualization, polarization analysis, historical observation cycles, and time-series comparisons, users can explore how Earth’s surface changes over time.

TerraWaltz combines satellite data processing, radar physics, geospatial analytics, and environmental storytelling in an accessible dashboard for researchers, students, environmental managers, and communities.

Our vision is to make complex Earth-observation data easier to understand and use, supporting better environmental awareness and informed decision-making. TerraWaltz transforms satellite observations into a clearer understanding of our planet’s changing rhythm.
details:
TerraWaltz is an interactive Earth-observation and geospatial intelligence platform designed to explore environmental changes across the Indian Sundarbans, West Bengal, using NASA–ISRO NISAR satellite radar data.

The platform transforms complex Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) observations into accessible visual insights through interactive 2D GIS mapping, 3D spatial visualization, radar polarization exploration, historical observation cycles, and environmental storytelling.

Its primary applications include flood and water-extent monitoring, mangrove vegetation analysis, shoreline and island change investigation, and agricultural and aquaculture monitoring. The platform is also designed for future integration of satellite-based forest-fire observations.

TerraWaltz uses a modular architecture combining web-based visualization, geospatial data processing, satellite data integration, and analytical workflows. Its interface provides different exploration modes for students, researchers, environmental managers, and the public.

Our innovation lies in connecting radar science with interactive environmental storytelling, making satellite observations easier to explore, compare, and understand. By organizing observations into historical cycles and presenting spatial changes visually, TerraWaltz aims to support environmental research, awareness, and better-informed decision-making.

Our long-term vision is to build an accessible environmental intelligence platform that helps people understand the changing rhythm of our planet.
